title: Chapter 275
text:
The two hosts analyzed the development of the main storyline in the two tables and focused on the theme of the show. They used Blue Star as an example to explain the characteristics of the main storyline to the players. There was also a discussion on the bullet screen. Players from other planets learned about the character Han Xiao from the show.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. This was not the first time his name appeared. After all, he had been around for so long, so it was normal for people to report about him.

It was not difficult to understand why the Galaxy Times had deduced another possibility for the main storyline. When he revealed his real identity, he also exposed his deeds. As long as the players tried to remove these deeds, it would not be difficult to logically deduce the original storyline. However, the number of players was huge, so it was hard to guarantee that no one would think of this.

From the perspective of the players, Han Xiao played a crucial role in the main storyline. Now that the storyline had been set, the other possibility was just a speculation. It could only be used to highlight his role in the storyline and make more players interested in him.

"I am very famous in Blue Star, but my fame is limited in the eyes of the players from other planets. I pushed the storyline forward and made the main storyline explode. Being chosen as the theme by the Galaxy Times is equivalent to indirectly promoting my fame," Han Xiao said.

"In summary, Black Phantom played a role in pushing the storyline forward in the main storyline," the female host said. "According to this example and the players' information, we can boldly speculate that every main storyline will have a core character like Han Xiao, who can be called the main character of the storyline, the main character of the planet. It can even be said that the current main storyline of each planet is derived from the main character of the planet … "

Han Xiao scratched his head.

In fact, the original main character of the storyline was the leader … Forget it, it is not important.

"In theory, every NPC can extend the storyline," the male host said. "Powerful NPCs with rich experience and deep backgrounds can naturally extend the storyline of more diverse events."

The male host changed the topic. "So, the limitations of the storyline characters are the limitations of the layout and the map. Take Black Phantom for example. He is the main character of a planet's main storyline, but will he still have other main storyline scenes in the future? Obviously, the probability is not high. His range of activity is limited to the novice planets. When the interstellar map is opened, the once important people will eventually disappear into the crowd. "

"As for those NPCs who have stepped into the stars, they would be able to extend to greater and more events. In comparison, the novice planet with the most potential is naturally the Void Demon's Winterfrost Planet, which is closely connected to the Galactic Faction. There is a high chance that a new storyline of a larger scale will be seamlessly connected with the changes in the version. As for low-level surface civilizations such as the Blue Star and the Longsong Planet, the prospects are not very optimistic …"

All sorts of comments flashed through the video. Some agreed, some disagreed. After analyzing Blue Star's situation, the next segment was an interview with a professional player. Han Xiao didn't continue watching.

He thought that the show was praising him, but he didn't expect that it would end up being used as a negative example to step on him. However, this analysis made sense. It was just like how the bosses in the beginner's village abused the players many times in the early stages, but when the players reached a higher level, these bosses were not even as good as a high-level monster. Han Xiao knew that Blue Star was indeed a novice planet with a low starting point.

However, understanding was one thing; this was another.

Thinking of his plan, Han Xiao smiled playfully. "Let's wait and see."

…

"Bang!"

The twisted door of the potion room was smashed into the room, smashing all the instruments on the two tables. Yi Yeqing, who had her back to the door, turned around in surprise. At the door, a figure with long red hair, Hella walked in with a cold expression.

"What do you want?" Yi Yeqing was vigilant. She flicked her finger, and green buds spread out from the cabinets around them, turning into tough and slender vines. They swayed slightly like poisonous snakes that were about to pounce on them.

Hella's body was surrounded by a dark red aura, and her eyes flashed red. She said coldly, "Hand over the things."

Yi Yeqing frowned and took a step to the side, revealing a row of test tubes on the table. They were all filled with bright red liquid. She shook her head and said, "You mean these potions? These are all strong healing potions cultivated from your sister's cell tissue. Do you want to try them? The effect is pretty good. "

Hella did not hesitate. She raised her hands, and a dark red light shot out. Yi Yeqing cursed in her heart and hurriedly protected the potions, controlling the plants to block.

Bang!

The dark red light was as sharp as a blade, and the vines were cut cleanly. The juice splattered everywhere. Yi Yeqing hurriedly dodged. The wall beside her was cut open, and dust sprayed out.

"Lunatic!" Yi Yeqing gritted her teeth and blocked. The dark red light and the green plants kept colliding. The potion room was torn apart by both parties. Dust filled the air, and the floor was a mess.

The guards outside were shocked. They raised their guns but did not know who to shoot.

"Go and inform His Excellency Black Phantom!" The captain of the guards hurriedly moved. Just as he took two steps, he saw a figure approaching quickly from the end of the road. It was Han Xiao.

Han Xiao was monitoring the potion room at all times. When he saw Yi Yeqing and Hella fighting, he immediately rushed to the scene and shouted, "Stop!"

Yi Yeqing was sweating. Her Esper ability was not as strong as Hella's, and she was worried that she would be injured if she stopped. "I will stop if she stops."

Hella's face was cold. She was determined to kill Yi Yeqing.

Han Xiao frowned. His blue Mechanical Force gathered on the sole of his foot. He stomped his foot, and the Mechanical Force seeped into the ground. The ground suddenly rumbled, and the ground in eight directions of the potion room cracked open.

Buzz!

Eight metal drills broke out of the ground, making mechanical clicking sounds. They quickly expanded into small turrets, and the barrels all turned to aim at the two of them.

The trap-type portable turret was a new type of machine buried in the important areas of the sanctuary. It could be activated through the chip program and the user's Mechanical Force.

"I think you forgot whose territory this is," Han Xiao said in a deep voice.

Hella clenched her teeth, retracted her hand, and stepped back. Her eyes were cold. Yi Yeqing heaved a sigh of relief. She rubbed her temples in pain. She had been hit by Hella's mental shockwave a few times, and her head was hurting.

"You didn't keep your promise to protect my sister." Hella suddenly turned around and stared at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao sighed helplessly. "You overreacted."

Yi Yeqing snorted, took out the potion, and said, "These are the potions I collected from Aurora's hair. This is called making the best use of everything. I didn't hurt your sister. Why are you so anxious?"

"That won't do!" Hella said coldly. Yi Yeqing's behavior was too similar to the Germinal Organization's. She was worried that the similar scene would remind Aurora of her painful experience.

The two of them did not back down. Han Xiao had a headache. It was not easy to solve a conflict between his own people.

At this time, Aurora rushed over in her wheelchair. Bear Cub was lying on her lap, bouncing up and down.

At this time, her complexion was much better than it had been a month ago. Her dry hair had become soft and smooth again, and her shriveled body had begun to gain weight. Her expression was radiant, and her face had become healthy and lustrous. The ability that had been suppressed for a long time had begun to take effect. In just a short month, Aurora had returned to the physical condition of a normal person.

"Sister, why did you fight with the doctor?" Aurora asked anxiously.

Yi Yeqing glared at Hella and told her the whole story.

Aurora was enlightened. She blinked and said, "It's just some hair. As long as I can help Uncle Han, I don't mind."

In the past, only her sister was good to her. Now, Han Xiao was also good to her. Aurora was very willing to contribute her role. Only then would she feel more at ease and feel that she could repay Han Xiao's kindness.

Han Xiao did not comment. He knew that Yi Yeqing's experiment was just some fallen hair. It was not too much, so he turned a blind eye to it. However, Hella's reaction was too extreme.

Aurora smiled brightly. "Sister, don't worry. I'm not that weak."

Hella was silent for a while. She turned around and left. She said in a low voice, "I know."

This little episode came to an end. Han Xiao asked the guards to clean up the scene. Yi Yeqing walked to him and said with a smile, "I didn't know that there were so many cannons near the potion lab. You were spying on me, right?"

Han Xiao glanced at her.

"Hehe, don't worry. I'm not that untactful. After all, I'm a tool that you exchanged for. Tools are meant to be manipulated by others." Yi Yeqing played with her hair and said with a playful smile.

"Oh." Han Xiao turned around and walked away.

Yi Yeqing's smile froze on her face. What kind of reaction was that? He was not angry or apologetic. He did not even threaten her. Was he that indifferent?

…

The moon and stars were hanging low. The night was dark.

After a day of manufacturing, Han Xiao stored the goods in the secret base. On the way back to his house, he suddenly saw a graceful figure sitting on the roof next door. The gentle moonlight illuminated half of the body. It was Hella. She was holding her chin and looking at the moon. It seemed that she had been sitting there for a while.

Han Xiao thought for a while and jumped up.

Hella heard the sound but did not turn around. She asked faintly, "What are you doing up here?"

"I came to take a look. Why are you not sleeping at night?"

Hella snorted and did not answer.

Han Xiao also sat down. He shook his head and said, "Your reaction today is too extreme. You didn't seem to be so impulsive before."

Hella frowned. "What does it have to do with you?"

"Well said. What does it have to do with me?" Han Xiao touched his chin and murmured, "Why didn't you say this when I saved your sister?"
